name: Ács (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two horizontal bands, white over red in the ratio 3:2, charged in the white with the town arms of Ács (a red shield with a white charge, within a green wreath, inscribed ÁCS and 1138).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
